name: Hermes Agent
short_desc: Autonomous AI agent for CLI - automate tasks with natural language

description: Hermes is an autonomous AI agent that runs in your terminal. Give it tasks in natural language and watch it execute complex workflows using tools like browsers, file systems, APIs, and more. Privacy-first with local model support.
